label: candidate

reviewEvidence.sourceTarget: Bottom row third figure, palette in anatomical right hand

observations: Optimized candidate retains the same tall asymmetric palette silhouette, open elongated thumb hole, front patch layout and plain rear as the original candidate.
Side/top/bottom views show finite body thickness and paint patches confined to the front face.
Reduced paint sampling produces visible faceting, particularly on the large blue, mint, pink and yellow patches; original patches read more smoothly rounded.
Body outline and bevel are slightly more angular at this inspection size, without an obvious filled hole or gross silhouette collapse.
comparisonWithOriginalCandidate.optimizationTradeoff: Useful lower-polygon candidate for further comparison; modest visible loss of paint-blob roundness remains.
comparisonWithOriginalCandidate.deviationNote: Builder-reported 0.003989 design-unit boundary deviation compares candidate to candidate, not to the source image.

unresolvedDifferences: Paint patches are simplified regular blobs; exact source count, irregular outlines, spacing and small smears are not reproduced or verified.
The source is foreshortened, so exact unforeshortened body contour and thumb-hole placement are unverified.
Thickness, plain rear, bevel profile, material response and arbitrary unit scale are inferred.
Grip fit and orientation relative to Yuna's accepted body have not been tested.

risks: Rendered colors come from simple material values; no source-faithful texture or material pass was verified.
Normal smoothing or slightly higher paint boundary sampling may be useful if close-up appearance matters.
Builder reports closed components and zero nonmanifold/degenerate faces, but this visual review did not independently recompute topology.
nextAction: Keep the candidate label. Revise source-facing paint shapes/layout and inspect shading, then fit to an accepted Yuna body before any final asset or integration approval.
